Each card supplies an office name, a short address label and an embedded map pin (latitude/longitude). Ingested as government_office / NATIONAL_AGENCY_OFFICE with precision=map_geocoded; the pin is not a surveyed building location. The locator is a regional-office subset, not a complete inventory of satellite, mall-based or host-agency service counters, and it does not state office hours or operating status.
